from opencode_server_processes process join user_opencode_process_bindings binding on binding.process_id = process.process_id and binding.user_id = process.user_id and binding.linux_server_id = process.linux_server_id and binding.port = process.port and binding.agent_id = 'opencode' and binding.status = 'ACTIVE' where process.status in ('RUNNING', 'UNHEALTHY')

, direct_run_activity as ( select eligible.user_id, max(run.updated_at) as last_run_at from eligible_processes eligible join runs run on run.triggered_by_user_id = eligible.user_id group by eligible.user_id ), legacy_run_activity as ( select eligible.user_id, max(run.updated_at) as last_run_at from eligible_processes eligible join sessions session_row on session_row.created_by_user_id = eligible.user_id join runs run on run.session_id = session_row.session_id and run.triggered_by_user_id is null group by eligible.user_id ), user_run_activity as ( select activity.user_id, max(activity.last_run_at) as last_run_at from ( select user_id, last_run_at from direct_run_activity union all select user_id, last_run_at from legacy_run_activity ) activity group by activity.user_id ), candidate_activity as ( select eligible.*, greatest( eligible.started_at, coalesce(activity.last_run_at, eligible.started_at) ) as last_activity_at from eligible_processes eligible left join user_run_activity activity on activity.user_id = eligible.user_id )
